Active Site Sorter

One of these molecules is bound to this protein in its experimental structure. Pick a piece, roll it over the surface and find where it fits. The faster you find it, the higher you score.

Protein

Pieces

How to play
  • Pick a piece from the tray. Only one belongs to this protein; the others stay cold blue everywhere.
  • Drag the piece to roll it over the surface. Shift-drag, or switch to Turn, to rotate it.
  • The piece turns from blue to red as you get closer to where it binds.
  • Near the site the piece rattles, then gets pulled in and slots into place. That's the win: the clock stops and it celebrates.
  • Your score drops with time and distance rolled.
  • Drag the background to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Double-click the protein to orbit around that spot.
  • A D spin the piece.
